data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: Defense store readers are forward-compatible: a reader that doesn't know dropped_by_arbiter must ignore the record gracefully (not crash); this is verified by a test that feeds an unknown defense_type to the reader

## TDD Requirement
Write a new failing test file: tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh

Test function: test_defense_store_drops_unknown_defense_type_gracefully

Given: a DEFENSE_RECORD comment on a mocked ticket containing a JSON record with defense_type="unknown_future_value" (an unrecognized enum value)
When: defense_store_load() is called with the matching prior_finding_id
Then: the function returns the record as-is (exit 0, non-null output) without crashing

Also write test: test_defense_store_write_persists_dropped_by_arbiter

Given: a valid defense record JSON including defense_type="dropped_by_arbiter"
When: defense_store_write() is called with TICKET_CMD=echo and DSO_SESSION_TICKET_ID set
Then: the stdout output contains defense_type and the string "dropped_by_arbiter"

Both tests must FAIL (RED) before implementation. Update .test-index with RED markers.

## Implementation Notes
- Test file location: tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh
- Source file: plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh
- Use the same pattern as tests/review/test-defense-store-ticket-binding.sh: source the library, set TICKET_CMD and DSO_SESSION_TICKET_ID
- For test_defense_store_drops_unknown_defense_type_gracefully: create a mock TICKET_CMD that returns a ticket JSON with a DEFENSE_RECORD comment containing defense_type="unknown_future_value"; assert exit code is 0 and output is not "null"
- For test_defense_store_write_persists_dropped_by_arbiter: inject a defense JSON with defense_type="dropped_by_arbiter" plus all required fields (prior_finding_id, defense_text ≤4096 chars, severity_history non-empty, ticket_id)
- Note: defense_store_write validates severity_history is non-empty — include it in the fixture
- The test file does NOT need fuzzy-match compatibility with review-defense-store.sh (basename "review-defense-store" vs "defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter" — no substring match). Requires explicit .test-index entry.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh
- [ ] Test test_defense_store_drops_unknown_defense_type_gracefully is present in the file
  Verify: grep -q "test_defense_store_drops_unknown_defense_type_gracefully" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh
- [ ] Test test_defense_store_write_persists_dropped_by_arbiter is present in the file
  Verify: grep -q "test_defense_store_write_persists_dropped_by_arbiter" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh
- [ ] Tests FAIL when run before implementation (RED signal confirmed)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/review/test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "^FAIL:"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_defense_store_drops_unknown_defense_type_gracefully] for plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh
  Verify: grep "\[test_defense_store_drops_unknown_defense_type_gracefully\]" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] .test-index updated with explicit entry mapping review-defense-store.sh to test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh
  Verify: grep -q "test-defense-store-dropped-by-arbiter.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED test: defense store readers ignore unknown defense_type gracefully
